_meta: Base perk ratings seeded from general PvE/PvP knowledge as of early 2026. VERIFY against the current season. Tiers: S (best) > A > B > C > D (avoid). Edit freely; per-weapon-type overrides are stored separately.

Reconstruction.reason: Auto-refills the magazine over the stowed cap; premier for heavy/special DPS weapons.

Bait and Switch.reason: Huge ~35% damage boost; top-tier DPS perk on rockets/LFRs/swords.

Envious Assassin.reason: Overflows the magazine well past cap before DPS; staple on burst-DPS heavies.

Envious Arsenal.reason: Overflows magazine from other-weapon kills; modern Envious successor.

Incandescent.reason: Scorch/ignition AoE on kills; best-in-class Solar ad-clear.

Voltshot.reason: Jolt on reload-after-kill; elite Arc ad-clear and chaining.

Destabilizing Rounds.reason: Volatile rounds on multikills; strong Void ad-clear and survivability.

Jolting Feedback.reason: Jolt on sustained damage; great Arc ad-clear on rapid-fire frames.

Hatchling.reason: Spawns Threadlings on kills/precision; good Strand ad-clear/synergy.

Headstone.reason: Creates a Stasis crystal on precision kill; strong Stasis synergy/control.

Chill Clip.reason: Slows and freezes; outstanding CC on fusions/glaives, also breaks overload.

Frenzy.reason: +damage, reload, handling after 12s in combat; always-on, no activation.

Rampage.reason: Stacking damage on kills; reliable in ad-dense content but falling off vs newer perks.

Kill Clip.reason: Big damage boost on reload-after-kill; excellent in PvE and PvP.

Multikill Clip.reason: Damage scales with multikills on reload; strong but needs ad density.

One for All.reason: Large 35% damage for ~10s after hitting 3 targets; great on ad-clear primaries.

Golden Tricorn.reason: Stacking damage with subclass-kill synergy; high ceiling on matched subclass.

Adrenaline Junkie.reason: Damage/handling from grenade kills; good on grenade-heavy builds.

Outlaw.reason: Fast reload on precision kills; evergreen consistency perk.

Rapid Hit.reason: Reload + stability on rapid precision hits; superb on snipers/pulses.

Feeding Frenzy.reason: Stacking reload on kills; strong consistency in ad-clear.

Subsistence.reason: Refills mag from reserves on kills; great uptime, drains reserves.

Demolitionist.reason: Grenade energy on kills + reload on grenade; core of ability builds.

Wellspring.reason: Ability energy on kills; solid generic build battery.

Pugilist.reason: Melee energy on kills + handling on melee; melee-build enabler.

Lead from Gold.reason: Refills reserves from ammo bricks; great ammo economy on heavies.

Auto-Loading Holster.reason: Reloads while stowed; near-mandatory on swap-DPS rockets/GLs.

Clown Cartridge.reason: Overfills mag on reload; pairs with auto-loaders for DPS.

Field Prep.reason: Reserves + faster reload crouched; ammo economy on special/heavy.

Fourth Time's the Charm.reason: Returns rounds to mag on rapid precision; ammo sustain on snipers.

Firefly.reason: Explosion on precision kill; classic Solar ad-clear, outclassed by Incandescent.

Dragonfly.reason: Elemental explosion on precision kill; decent ad-clear.

Explosive Payload.reason: Area damage on impact; consistent damage and flinch.

Vorpal Weapon.reason: +damage vs bosses/vehicles/Guardians; solid floor for DPS.

Target Lock.reason: Ramps damage the longer you stay on target; superb on SMGs/autos.

Cascade Point.reason: Massively boosts fire rate after an ability kill; huge burst DPS.

Repulsor Brace.reason: Void overshield on Void-debuffed kill; core Void survivability.

Collective Action.reason: Damage boost after using your gained class ability via Prismatic; strong with current builds.

Attrition Orbs.reason: Generates Orbs of Power on sustained damage; nice for ability uptime.

Discord.reason: Reloads stowed weapon and makes ammo bricks on ranged final blows.

Snapshot Sights.reason: Faster ADS; best-in-slot QoL for snipers/precision PvP.

Opening Shot.reason: First-shot accuracy/range; excellent on hand cannons/scouts in PvP.

Eye of the Storm.reason: Accuracy/handling as health drops; clutch dueling perk.

Killing Wind.reason: Mobility/range/handling after a kill; aggressive PvP snowball.

Moving Target.reason: Movement speed + target acquisition; solid PvP consistency.

Zen Moment.reason: Stability/recoil on damage; tames PvP recoil on autos/pulses.

Dynamic Sway Reduction.reason: Reduces sway on sustained fire; great on autos/SMGs PvP.

Perpetual Motion.reason: Stability/handling/reload while moving; always-on PvP comfort.

Keep Away.reason: Range/reload when no enemies are near; rewards spacing in PvP.

Slideshot.reason: Range/stability + partial reload on slide; aggressive PvP fusions/pulses.

Slideways.reason: Stability/handling + partial reload on slide; mobile PvP perk.

Tunnel Vision.reason: Big aim assist/target acquisition + reload after reloading near enemies.

Closing Time.reason: Handling/stability as mag empties; nice on aggressive frames.

Thresh.reason: Small super energy on kills; minor, generic.

Enlightened Action.reason: Reload/handling stack on damage; modest QoL.

Strategist.reason: Class ability energy + reload on elemental kills; niche.

Sword Logic.reason: Stacking damage vs tougher enemies on kills; sword-specific DPS.

Heal Clip.reason: Reload after a kill heals you and nearby allies; excellent survivability primary.

Onslaught.reason: Stacking fire-rate on rapid kills; strong sustained ad-clear/DPS on autos/pulses.

Killing Tally.reason: Stacking damage with kills, reset on reload/stow; good in ad-dense PvE.

Swashbuckler.reason: Stacking damage from kills (melee maxes it); strong on swords/SMGs.

Surrounded.reason: Big damage when 3+ enemies are near; great in ad density (swords/GLs).

Slice.reason: Sever on slide/dodge shots; debuff utility for Strand.

Unrelenting.reason: Heal on rapid kills; survivability filler in horde content.

Eddy Current.reason: Reload + bonus damage while amplified/sprinting; Arc synergy.

Beacon Rounds.reason: Jolts on multikill (Arc); modern Arc ad-clear trait.

Air Trigger.reason: Reload + bonus damage while airborne; mobile DPS.

Master of Arms.reason: Bonus damage from any-kind kills; flexible always-on damage.

Stats for All.reason: All-around stat boost after hitting 3 targets; consistent QoL.

Dual Loader.reason: Loads two rounds at once; speeds GL/LFR DPS reloads.

Successful Warm-Up.reason: Faster charge/handling on kills; helps fusions/LFRs.

Sympathetic Arsenal.reason: Reloads stowed weapons on reload; swap-DPS enabler.

Hip-Fire Grip.reason: Improves hip-fire accuracy/range; niche aggressive PvP.

Threat Detector.reason: Stability/reload/handling when enemies are close; close-range PvP.

Well-Rounded.reason: Ramps range/stability/handling on kills; solid generalist.
